summary: {elections_official} sends the barrier list to the owner of a borrowed polling place.
realLife: Merced agreed to write to outside polling-site owners and operators about identified barriers and enclose the federal checklist.
gates: The county uses another owner's polling site and an inspection has found a barrier.
inGame: needs: the precinct, facility owner, listed barrier and repair request.

turns.what: The county requests a date for the follow-up inspection.
turns.pulledBy: The owner agrees to fix the entrance.
turns.writesBack: The site record carries a repair commitment.

turns.what: Election staff start looking for an accessible alternative.
turns.pulledBy: The owner declines to alter the doorway.
turns.writesBack: The site file records the owner's answer.
